versions.title_at_revision: Electrical bonding and protection against static
versions.text: electricity; EWIS (See AMC 25.1715) (a) EWIS components used for electrical bonding and protection against static electricity must meet the requirements of CS 25.899. (b) Electrical bonding provided by EWIS components must provide an adequate electrical return path under both normal and fault conditions, on aeroplanes having earthed electrical systems (see CS 25.1353(e)).
